---
title: "Methods and data preparation"
---

The package uses a pinned copy of the Our World in Data COVID-19 archive.
Run `Rscript data-raw/prepare.R` from the repository root to rebuild the
packaged dataset.

The script selects Australia and New Zealand and keeps complete reporting
weeks from Monday through Sunday in 2021. It verifies seven distinct dates and
a single positive population value in each country-week, then checks that
102 country-weeks remain.

Weekly reported cases are summed and divided by population, then expressed per
100,000 residents. The latest available coverage reading and its observation
date are retained for each week. Missing observations stay missing.

The milestone is the first available weekly observation at or above the
chosen coverage threshold. The peak is the highest reported case rate within
the chosen date range, with ties resolved in favour of the earliest week.
The interval subtracts the milestone reporting week's Sunday from the peak
reporting week's Sunday and divides by seven. This describes the order and
distance between reporting weeks. It cannot establish vaccine effectiveness.
